params.name: definition
params.description: Filter entities by their entity definition identifier

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of entities to skip for pagination

params.name: take
params.description: Maximum number of entities to return

params.name: culture
params.description: Culture code for multi-lingual property values (e.g., en-US)

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of entities from the Content Hub. Supports filtering by entity definition, property values, and relations. The response includes hyperlinks for navigating to related resources.

Creates a new entity in Content Hub according to the specified entity definition. The entity type is determined by the definition identifier provided in the request body. Properties and relations are set according to the definition schema.

params.name: id
params.description: The numeric identifier of the entity

params.name: culture
params.description: Culture code for localized properties (e.g., en-US)

items.docs: Retrieves a specific entity by its numeric identifier. Returns the entity with all its properties, relations, and hypermedia links. Use the culture parameter to retrieve localized property values.

params.name: id
params.description: The numeric identifier of the entity

items.docs: Performs a full replacement update of an entity. All properties and relations are replaced with the values in the request body. Missing optional properties will be cleared.

params.name: id
params.description: The numeric identifier of the entity

items.docs: Permanently deletes an entity from Content Hub. This operation is irreversible. Assets that are in use or have active relations may require the relations to be removed first.

params.name: id
params.description: The numeric identifier of the entity

items.docs: Updates the lifecycle state of an entity such as an asset. Lifecycle state transitions control the publishing workflow of assets within Content Hub (e.g., Draft, Approved, Published).

Executes a structured query against the Content Hub entity index. Supports filtering by property values, relations, and entity definition using a query expression language. Returns matching entities with pagination.

Executes a full-text and structured search query across the Content Hub entity index. Returns matching entities with facet aggregations for interactive filtering. Supports relevance ranking and pagination.
Initiates a new asset upload into Content Hub by creating an upload request. Returns a target URL and upload identifier used for the subsequent binary file upload step.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of jobs to skip for pagination

params.name: take
params.description: Maximum number of jobs to return

items.docs: Retrieves a list of background job targets configured in the Content Hub instance. Jobs handle long-running operations such as asset processing, reporting, and data exports.
Retrieves all entity selections across selection pools. Selections group entities for bulk operations such as download, export, or editorial actions.
Creates a new entity selection in a specified selection pool. Selections hold a list of entity identifiers for subsequent bulk operations.

params.name: entityId
params.description: Filter audit entries by entity identifier

params.name: userId
params.description: Filter audit entries by the user who made the change

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for audit entry filtering (ISO 8601)

params.name: to
params.description: End date for audit entry filtering (ISO 8601)

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip for pagination

params.name: take
params.description: Maximum number of entries to return

items.docs: Retrieves and queries audit log entries that record all changes made to entities and configuration within the Content Hub instance. Supports filtering by entity, user, date range, and operation type.

Creates a download order that packages one or more assets for delivery. Download orders can specify renditions, file formats, and delivery options. The order is processed asynchronously and the download URL is provided upon completion.
